The specification also includes colored inner details, special leather trim, and black leather/Alcantara carpeting. Who This Program Is For (...and not for) A good fit if you:  Want the lowest possible purchase price and accept repair risk.  Are comfortable with DIY fixes or have a trusted shop.  Need a work truck, second car, teens first car, or basic runabout.  Are okay with cosmetic wear and potential mechanical needs.  Not a good fit if you:  Want turn-key reliability and retail-level reconditioning.  Prefer warranty coverage or certified pre-owned standards.  Dont have budget set aside for repairs after purchase. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Brake assist - Stop right there.  Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now!  With brake assist, you will.  It uses the speed of the brake pedals travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one. Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. The GLIs standard limited-slip differential optimizes traction, distributing power efficiently to the front wheels to maintain grip when the road throws a curveball. Beneath its aggressive stance, 18-inch alloy wheels wrapped in performance tires complete the bold aesthetic and provide impeccable road-holding capabilities. Recaro sport seats, upholstered in a durable combination of leather and microfiber, firmly cradle your body even under the most spirited driving sessions, while offering unwavering support for long hauls. The cabin layout is purposeful, driver-focused, and packed with cutting-edge technology. description: The 2023 Chevrolet Bolt EUV LT is one of those electric vehicles that makes the transition to EV ownership feel remarkably easy. Finished in Ghost Gray Metallic over a Jet Black interior, it has a sharp, understated look while giving you the added passenger space and more substantial feel of Chevrolet's EUV body style. It is compact enough to make commuting, parking, and running around Sacramento simple, yet roomy enough inside to work as an everyday family vehicle.Behind the wheel, the Bolt EUV feels modern without making everything unnecessarily complicated. Electronic Precision Shift keeps the center area clean and easy to use, while One Pedal Drive allows you to handle much of your everyday acceleration and deceleration using the accelerator pedal alone. A Normal/Sport drive mode selector lets you tailor the response to the drive, and this Bolt is equipped with DC fast-charging provisions along with the 11.5-kW onboard charging module and dual-level charge cord for added flexibility when charging at home or on the road.The cabin is centered around Chevrolet's large 10.2-inch HD color touchscreen with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus, wireless Apple CarPlay, wireless Android Auto, Bluetooth audio streaming, voice recognition, available connected apps, and personalization capability. You also get wireless device charging, keyless open and start, remote vehicle start, an 8-inch multi-color Driver Information Center, and dedicated efficiency displays that make it easy to monitor energy use and program charging times.Chevrolet also gave the Bolt EUV LT an impressive amount of driver-assistance technology. Chevy Safety Assist brings Automatic Emergency Braking, Front Pedestrian Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning, Following Distance Indicator, and IntelliBeam automatic high beams. This example goes a step further with the Driver Confidence Package, adding Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert and Rear Cross Traffic Alert, along with Rear Park Assist and an HD Rear Vision Camera. For everyday driving, tight parking lots, freeway lane changes, and the morning commute, those are features you quickly come to appreciate.Outside, LED headlamps, LED daytime running lamps, LED taillamps, heated power-adjustable mirrors with integrated turn signals, and 17-inch aluminum wheels give the Bolt EUV a clean and contemporary appearance. The Cargo Convenience Package adds an all-weather cargo mat and cargo net, while the 60/40 split-folding rear seat makes it easy to open up additional cargo room when needed.What makes the Bolt EUV appealing is how naturally it can fit into normal life. There is no oversized SUV footprint to deal with, no gasoline station stop built into the weekly routine, and no sacrifice in the technology people expect from a newer vehicle. It is an easy commuter, a comfortable run-around vehicle, and a practical way to get into an EV without feeling like you are driving something overly complicated or experimental.Come see this Ghost Gray Metallic 2023 Chevrolet Bolt EUV LT in person at Prestige Wholesale in Sacramento, take it for a drive, and experience how simple an electric daily driver can be.
